user.title: Set up Streaming Finder
user.description: Country (two letters, e.g. DE) and language for titles. The TMDB key is required for “Where can I watch …?” and for anime availability in your country; without it the anime season lists worldwide platforms from AniList. You can add the key later under “Configure”.

error.land_ungueltig: Please enter a two-letter country code (e.g. DE).

schluessel.title: TMDB key
schluessel.description: Leave empty to work without TMDB.

konto.title: Connect TMDB account
konto.description:
1. Open [this link to TMDB]({link}) and click **Approve** (you must be signed in to TMDB).
2. Come back here and press **Submit**.

Your watchlist then appears as a list in Home Assistant. Checking off or deleting removes a title from the watchlist; adding puts the best TMDB match on it.

trennen.title: Disconnect TMDB account
trennen.description: The watchlist disappears from Home Assistant; it stays unchanged on TMDB.

error.nicht_freigegeben: TMDB reports no approval yet – please approve on the TMDB page first.

abort.erst_schluessel: Please enter the TMDB key first.

wo_laeuft.name: Where to watch
wo_laeuft.description: Which streaming services offer a series or film in the configured country (subscription, free, with ads, rent, buy).

titel.name: Title
titel.description: Name of the series or film

anime_saison.name: Anime season
anime_saison.description: The most popular anime of a season with status, next episode and platforms.

saison.name: Season
saison.description: Winter, spring, summer or fall; empty = current

merkliste.name: Watchlist
merkliste.description: Entries of the connected TMDB watchlist with streaming offers in the country.

merkliste_entfernen.name: Remove from watchlist
merkliste_entfernen.description: Takes a title off the TMDB watchlist. The title may be shortened, slightly misheard or given in its original language.
